categories.main_business_segments: The Group's primary business segments include cable assembly, digital cable, and server products. It serves various sectors such as telecommunication, data centre, medical equipment, industrial equipment, automotive wire harness, and specialty cables. The Group operates on a contract manufacturing services (CMS) basis, producing customized cable and server products to customer specifications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group utilizes customized manufacturing platforms for copper and optical fiber cable assemblies, digital cables, medical products, and servers. It emphasizes flexible production capabilities with extensive quality control and invests significantly in R&D, especially in medical equipment cables and server products. The Group also leverages patented wearable haptics technology through strategic investments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include established PRC and international companies in telecommunications, data centres, healthcare, automotive, and industrial sectors. Major customers contributing over 10% of revenue are from the server and cable assembly segments. The Group also targets emerging markets such as medical equipment and electric vehicle sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group is headquartered in Hong Kong with manufacturing facilities in Shanghai, Suzhou, Jiangxi, Huizhou (China), Japan, and Mexico. It has liaison offices in the United States and the United Kingdom and a joint venture in Singapore. Major markets include Mainland China, the United States, Singapore, the Netherlands, Hong Kong, Mexico, and the United Kingdom.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a contract manufacturer of customized interconnect solutions, including cable assemblies and servers. It sources raw materials, including from Luxshare Precision Industry, and provides manufacturing and assembly services to its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include becoming a Tier-1 supplier in telecommunication, data communication, healthcare, automotive, and industrial sectors. The Group focuses on expanding its product range, enhancing R&D capabilities, especially in medical equipment cables and server products, and leveraging AI-driven demand growth. It pursues business diversification through investments in medical and health-related companies and geographic expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through fixed-price, short-term contracts for manufacturing and sales of cable assembly products, digital cables, and servers. The Group operates on a made-to-order basis upon receipt of customer orders and adjusts prices based on raw material costs such as copper. It also earns income from subcontracting services and strategic investments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the Group positions itself as a well-established, customer-driven interconnect solutions provider with over 30 years of experience. It aims to be a preferred supplier recognized for world-class quality and service, leveraging strategic alliances with Luxshare Precision Industry to enhance competitiveness and market reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended 31 December 2024, the Group reported revenue of HK$7,388.8 million, a 53.1% increase from the prior period, with a net profit of HK$450.5 million, up 62.3%. The Group's gross profit margin improved to 14.6%, and net profit margin to 6.1%. Shareholders’ funds increased by 29.8% to HK$1,766.2 million. The Group has expanded its workforce to over 6,000 employees and continues to invest in capital expenditures and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The Group emphasizes customized, flexible production platforms tailored to individual customer specifications, supported by extensive quality control. It leverages deep industry knowledge, long-term stable relationships with market leaders, and strategic investments in innovative medical and haptics technologies. Its integration with Luxshare Precision Industry enhances its technological capabilities, product range, and global market access, differentiating it as a comprehensive interconnect solutions provider.
